AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Aistee counts tokens locally in explicitly provided inline text. Call countTokens only after a fresh user request, with userRequested=true. Never pass conversation history, credentials or unrelated context. Aistee Privacy consent, enabled Docbench and App lock off are required. No chat, file, account or network access. Maximum 20,000 UTF-16 characters. Returns count and encoding only.
